scope: Validate exact earlier ordinary views, complete output field kinds, and ordinary-view placement without extending materialized declarations.

common: \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($name !== null && !$guard, 'Schema views require an unguarded, statically named namespace.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($view->name->schema->value === $name->value && $view->query->release === $release, 'A schema view must belong to its namespace and release.');
\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input(!isset($occupied[$coordinate]), 'A schema view requires an unused relation name.');
\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($view !== null, 'A schema view must resolve its local view input to a preceding ordinary view.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($source->kind === \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\From\ExternalRelationKind::BaseTable && $local !== null, 'A schema view must resolve its local input to a preceding base table.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input(isset($fields[$column->value]) && $fields[$column->value] === $source->columnKind($slot), 'A schema view requires each local input field in the checked native kind.');

$heading = \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::listOf($columns, \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\Identifier::class, 'A persistent view needs a nonempty ordered heading.', 1);

\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($check === \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\Schema\View\ViewCheckOption::None, 'A view check option requires a simple base-table projection.');
\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input(!$query->distinct && $query->orderBy === [] && $query->limit === null, 'CREATE VIEW requires an unbounded ordinary projection.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($source === null || $source instanceof \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\TableSource && ($source->kind === \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\From\ExternalRelationKind::BaseTable || $ordinaryViewSource && $source->kind === \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\From\ExternalRelationKind::View), 'CREATE VIEW requires no source or one supported persistent relation.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($check === \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\Schema\View\ViewCheckOption::None || $source instanceof \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\TableSource && $source->kind === \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\From\ExternalRelationKind::BaseTable, 'A view check option requires a simple base-table projection.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($source->schema->value !== 'pg_temp' && preg_match('/\Apg_(?:toast_)?temp_[0-9]+\z/D', $source->schema->value) === 0, 'CREATE VIEW requires a persistent source schema.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($name->schema->value !== $source->schema->value || $name->view->value !== $source->table->value, 'A persistent view definition cannot read its own identity.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input(!$expression instanceof \SqlSemantics\Platform\PostgreSql\Ir\Binding\Parameter, 'A persistent view definition cannot bind a native parameter.');
